how.title: How Tarteeba works
how.step1Body: Set the number of cleaners, your address and what matters most.
how.step2Body: You only see days and slots that are actually available in your area.
how.step3Body: We place a hold on your card without charging it, and your request is pending confirmation.
how.step4Body: Our team confirms availability, then the charge goes through and you track the arrival in the app.
how.note: A booking is final only after our bookings team confirms it. If the slot can't be served, we suggest alternatives or release the hold.

why.title: Why Tarteeba
why.punctualBody: We plan vehicle routes before every slot and notify you when the car leaves and the cleaner arrives.
why.preferredBody: We prioritise your preferred cleaner, and may send a trained substitute when she's not available.
why.trainedBody: Cleaners employed by Tarteeba, with valid documents and a quality check after every visit.
why.clearBody: You see VAT, fees and the expected refund before you confirm anything.
why.secureBody: Card, Apple Pay or Google Pay through the payment gateway. We never store your card details.
why.careBody: Rate every visit, and open a complaint linked to the booking that we follow through to resolution.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.a1: After you send a request it's pending confirmation. Our bookings team checks cleaner and vehicle availability, then confirms, and you get a notification either way.
faq.a2: When you send the request we only place a hold on your card. You're charged when we confirm; if we don't, the hold is released.
faq.q3: Will I get the same cleaner every time?
faq.a3: We prioritise your preferred cleaner but can't guarantee she's available for every visit. If she's away we send a trained substitute and let you know in advance.
faq.q4: Do I need to provide cleaning materials?
faq.a4: You choose during booking. If the company provides them, the fee shows in the price summary before you pay.
faq.q5: How do I cancel or reschedule?
faq.a5: From the booking details in the app. We show the fee and expected refund under the policy before you confirm.
faq.a6: We first check the result with the payment gateway before showing any message. Then you can retry or change the method without being charged twice.

dropoff_dwell_minutes.label: Time at each stop (minutes)
dropoff_dwell_minutes.description: Minutes a van spends at a stop to drop off or pick up cleaners. The trip planner adds it between stops.

plan_extra_rounds.label: Draft an extra round when a van has already left
plan_extra_rounds.description: When a van's round for the slot has already left, drafting rounds plans an extra round for the visits it does not cover, departing once a van and driver are free. Off: those visits are listed as not planned (round under way). An extra round already drafted is still extended.

extra_round_prefer_other_van.label: Put the extra round on another free van first
extra_round_prefer_other_van.description: With extra rounds on, drafting first puts those visits on another van that is free and has the seats (their seat reservations move with them), rather than a later second trip of the same van. Without such a van, it plans the second trip.

auto_start_after_min.label: Start visits automatically (minutes after arrival)
auto_start_after_min.description: When nobody starts a visit, it starts this many minutes after the team arrives. 0 starts it as soon as the driver drops the team off.

auto_complete_grace_minutes.label: Complete visits automatically (minutes after the slot)
auto_complete_grace_minutes.description: A visit still open this many minutes after its slot ends is completed by the system.

sms_on_confirm.label: Text message on confirmation
sms_on_confirm.description: Also send an SMS when a booking is confirmed, in addition to the app notification.

estimated_arrival_text.label: Refund arrival estimate
estimated_arrival_text.description: Shown with every refund until the payment provider gives its own estimate.

auto_fetch.label: Fetch the settlement report from the payment provider every day
auto_fetch.description: The report is fetched and matched with our payments every day. Turn it off to upload the report by hand.

settlement_lag_days.label: Days a transaction may appear late in the provider's report
settlement_lag_days.description: A payment can show up in the provider's report a day or more after it was taken. Items inside this window are not reported as missing.

amount_tolerance_fils.label: Amount difference still counted as a match (fils)
amount_tolerance_fils.description: 0 means the amounts must match exactly. 100 fils is 1 AED.

enabled.label: Customer balance (wallet) is on
enabled.description: While it is off, customers see no balance and cannot pay with it. Balances already issued stay on record.

credit_validity_days.label: Days a free credit stays valid (0 = never expires)
credit_validity_days.description: Applies to credit given as compensation or goodwill. 0 means it never expires.

expiry_notice_days.label: Days before expiry to remind the customer (0 = no reminder)
expiry_notice_days.description: The customer is reminded once, this many days before the credit expires.

window_days.label: Days after the visit (or cancellation) a complaint can be opened
window_days.description: After this many days the customer is asked to contact us instead.

sla_clock.label: Count complaint deadlines in working hours or round the clock
sla_clock.description: Working hours count only the company's opening hours; round the clock counts every minute.

sla_targets.label: First-reply and resolution targets per priority, in minutes
sla_targets.description: Minutes from opening a case to the first reply, and to its resolution, for each priority.

default_priorities.label: Starting priority per category and per low rating
default_priorities.description: A new case starts with the priority set here for its category, or for the star rating that opened it.

auto_close_days.label: Days without a customer reply before a resolved or waiting case closes
auto_close_days.description: A resolved case, or one waiting for the customer, closes by itself after this many days of silence.

sla_alert_minutes.label: Alert this many minutes before a complaint deadline
sla_alert_minutes.description: Staff are alerted on the overview when a deadline is this close, and again when it is missed.

types.label: Compensation options offered on complaints (a credit also needs the balance on)
types.description: The options staff can propose on a case. A balance credit needs the customer balance to be on.

deletion_grace_days.label: Days of cooling-off before an account deletion is carried out
deletion_grace_days.description: The customer can cancel the deletion during this time.

export_available_days.label: Days a data copy stays available to download
export_available_days.description: After this many days the download link stops working and the copy is deleted.

deletion_stuck_alert_days.label: Alert about a deletion still waiting after this many days
deletion_stuck_alert_days.description: Staff are alerted when a deletion request is still not completed after this many days.

default_alert_days.label: Days before expiry to alert, for new worker documents
default_alert_days.description: Used for a new document when no alert days are given for it.

expiry_reminder_days.label: Extra reminders before a document expires (days)
expiry_reminder_days.description: Up to three extra reminders, counting down, for example 30, 14, 7. Leave it empty for none.

document_alert_days.label: Days before a vehicle or driver document expires to alert
document_alert_days.description: Vehicle and driver documents are flagged on the fleet pages and the overview this many days before they expire.

backdate_days.label: How many days back attendance may be recorded
backdate_days.description: Attendance older than this can no longer be recorded or changed.

rating_window_days.label: Days of ratings counted in a worker's average
rating_window_days.description: Only ratings from this many recent days count towards the worker's average.

steps.service: A rule for one service wins over an all-services rule.
steps.weekday: A rule for one weekday wins over an every-day rule.
steps.latest: If they are still equal, the most recently changed rule wins.
